summary: The diff implements the plan's contract exactly. src/rivretrieve/_internal/discovery.py replaces top-level products() with `products(provider: str | None = None) -> list[str]`, matching the plan's prescribed implementation shape verbatim: it registers defaults, validates the provider against _registry.list_provider_ids() and raises UnknownProviderError(provider) directly for unknown or malformed strings, selects the scoped record set, and returns the sorted deduplicated product_id set read through the existing CatalogueReader.read_products(). No product-row field other than product_id escapes, no source/filter/issue-policy parameter is added, and product_info(), _global_products(), src/rivretrieve/__init__.py, ProviderHandle, CatalogueReader, provider modules, and all packaged artifacts are untouched (git show confirms _global_products is byte-identical and product_info still delegates to it). The six modified paths are exactly the plan write-set: no fixture, parquet, lockfile, contract, version, or documentation change. Test quality is genuine rather than smoke: the acceptance test asserts the exact twelve-element global list, exact provider-key order against rr.providers(), the exact list per provider scope, sortedness, subset membership, and built-in-list identity; the shape test rules out CatalogResult and pl.DataFrame; the unknown-provider test pins the exact message text, the provider_id attribute, and an empty IssuePolicyError chain. The reader-delegation test keeps its monkeypatch and the exact {"stations": 1, "products": 2} call count while now also asserting both public forms' results, so it proves delegation rather than merely exercising it. The two deleted tests in test_m5_exit_criteria.py introspected metadata columns on the removed public table shape and are superseded by the exact vocabulary assertion; no surviving assertion is weakened, and the catalogue-only files' provider-handle and module table assertions are untouched, so the retained internal contract stays covered. Reviewer-refusal checks are clean: exactly one commit with the required subject and an empty body, no attribution footer, no tag or version bump, pr-body.md untracked with the exact prescribed contents, and no lint or type suppression added. PR body claims match the diff.
